checkpoint_questions.expected_answer: Yes — gravity and the normal force, which balance to zero net force.
checkpoint_questions.question: A book rests on a table. Is a force acting on it?

entry_ticket.expected_response: Any example of continued motion, e.g. a rolling ball.
entry_ticket.prompt: Name one situation where something kept moving after you stopped pushing it.

exit_ticket.prompt: In one sentence, why do passengers lurch forward when a bus brakes?
exit_ticket.success_indicator: Answer refers to continued motion, not to a forward force.

tasks: Find two examples of inertia at home and explain each in one sentence.

mentor_moment.story: Newton developed much of his work on motion while Cambridge was closed during an outbreak, working alone at his family home.
mentor_moment.takeaway: Progress often comes from steady thinking in unpromising conditions.
mentor_moment.title: Newton in a plague year
